rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
LC circuit oscillates with f0 = 1/(2π√LC).
At resonance inductive and capacitive reactances cancel.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Impedance is minimum (= R) and current maximum at resonance.  ·  Energy alternates between the capacitor's field and the inductor's field.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Trick 3: Maximum Energy U = q_max²/2C = ½L I_max².  ·  Trick 4: Current is zero when charge is maximum.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Solve problems calculating the frequency of LC oscillations.  ·  Derive the differential equation for LC oscillations: d²q/dt² + (1/LC)q = 0.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Trick 5: Charge is zero when current is maximum.  ·  Understand the graphical representation of energy.
